def _read_lines(data: bytes, reclen: int):
    recs = []
    if not data:
        return recs
    parts = data.split(b"\n")
    if parts and parts[-1] == b"":
        parts = parts[:-1]
    for p in parts:
        r = p[:reclen]
        r = r + b" " * (reclen - len(r))
        recs.append(r)
    return recs


def _fit(b: bytes, n: int) -> bytes:
    b = b[:n]
    return b + b" " * (n - len(b))


def _num2(v: int) -> bytes:
    return b"%02d" % (v % 100)

    out = bytearray(b" " * 16)
